notes: Well-formedness of the pointer / segment framing. Table contents need generated code.

cases.title: Empty struct pointer is null
cases.paragraph: A null pointer is eight zero bytes and means an empty / default value.

cases.title: Shorter than one pointer word
cases.paragraph: Every pointer is 64 bits. A 4-byte buffer is not a message.

cases.title: Empty buffer is not a message
cases.paragraph: A message starts with a segment-count word.

cases.title: Segment table claims a segment that is missing
cases.paragraph: The first word is (segment count − 1). The declared words must follow.
